about: How the outcome web's death-rate factors reach a person's hazard: which web outcome stands for which ages, and what share of deaths at each age a traffic crash stands for.

source.citation: Insurance Institute for Highway Safety, Fatality Facts, Yearly snapshot: motor vehicle crash deaths per 100,000 people by age group, 2022 (https://www.iihs.org/topics/fatality-statistics/detail/yearly-snapshot). All road users: under 13, 859 deaths, 1.7; 13 to 19, 2,896 deaths, 9.6; 20 to 34, 12,282 deaths, 18.0; 35 to 69, 20,832 deaths, 14.4; 70 and over, 5,658 deaths, 14.4.
